arguments:
{"script":"mkdir -p cpu_check_temp
cd cpu_check_temp || exit 1
# metadata
echo "{\"created\":\"$(date -u +%FT%TZ)\"}" > cpu_check_metadata.json
# initialize log
: > cpu_check.log
# gather processor-related info
lscpu >> cpu_check.log 2>&1
echo '--- /proc/cpuinfo ---' >> cpu_check.log
cat /proc/cpuinfo >> cpu_check.log 2>&1
# dmidecode may require privileges; attempt but don't fail
dmidecode -t processor >> cpu_check.log 2>&1 || true
# extract identifiable processor entries
grep -i -E '(^processor|physical id|core id|cpu cores|siblings|socket|processor information|cpu\(s\))' cpu_check.log > cpu_raw_entries.txt || true
# compute candidate counts
logical=$(nproc --all 2>/dev/null || grep -c '^processor' /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
sockets_lscpu=$(lscpu 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '/Socket\(s\)/{gsub(/ /,"",$2);print $2}')
cores_per_socket=$(lscpu 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '/Core\(s\) per socket:/{gsub(/ /,"",$2);print $2}')
physical_proc=$(grep '^physical id' /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $4}' | sort -u | wc -l 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
# normalize unknowns
if [ -z "$sockets_lscpu" ]; then sockets_lscpu="unknown"; fi
if [ -z "$cores_per_socket" ]; then cores_per_socket="unknown"; fi
if [ "$physical_proc" -eq 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then physical_proc="unknown"; fi
# implied logical if possible
if [ "$sockets_lscpu" != "unknown" ] && [ "$cores_per_socket" != "unknown" ]; then
  implied=$((sockets_lscpu * cores_per_socket))
else
  implied="unknown"
fi
# write candidates
cat <<EOF > cpu_count_candidates.txt
logical_count: $logical
sockets_lscpu: $sockets_lscpu
cores_per_socket: $cores_per_socket
physical_ids_in_proc: $physical_proc
implied_logical_from_lscpu: $implied
EOF
# checks and issues
: > cpu_check_issues.txt
if [ "$implied" != "unknown" ]; then
  if [ "$implied" -ne "$logical" ]; then
    echo "Mismatch: lscpu implied logical ($implied) != detected logical ($logical)" >> cpu_check_issues.txt
  fi
fi
if [ "$physical_proc" = "unknown" ]; then
  echo "physical id not found in /proc/cpuinfo; cannot determine physical package count from /proc/cpuinfo" >> cpu_check_issues.txt
fi
# summary without stating the number
cat <<'EOF' > cpu_count_summary.txt
Final verification rationale:
- Combined sources consulted: /proc/cpuinfo, lscpu, dmidecode (if available).
- Where lscpu provided socket and cores-per-socket, their product was cross-checked against logical CPU count.
- If /proc/cpuinfo lists physical ids, that was used to estimate physical packages.
- Any mismatches were recorded in cpu_check_issues.txt.
Note: The verified CPU count is recorded separately for reporting.
EOF
# output the number only
printf "%s" "$logical"
"}
